nodes.label: Sidebar component
nodes.rationale: Dark-brown primary rail for desktop admin; hidden below 900px (use BottomNav). Active item is the only gold element.

nodes.label: Tabs component
nodes.rationale: Active underline gold 2px; never colour whole tab gold.

nodes.label: TopBar component
nodes.rationale: Sits on page cream, not a card; wraps to two rows under ~700px; never truncate action cluster.

nodes.label: Brand lockup in UI (wordmark on dark rail)
nodes.norm_label: brand lockup in ui (wordmark on dark rail)
nodes.rationale: On dark rail the logo becomes spaced uppercase wordmark; min height 20px; clearspace = height of the O.

nodes.label: Gold-gema palette (action colour)
nodes.rationale: Action/highlight colour, only on small elements, never large background; gold-400 #D4A437 is --action-primary.

nodes.label: Marrom-terra palette
nodes.rationale: Support and structure: emphasis text, icons, solid blocks; brown-700 #4A3F2E is body text.

nodes.label: Data colours (chart series)
nodes.rationale: Positive vivid green, negative vivid red; category series follows brand.

nodes.label: Indicators in use (delta, badge, bar, status dot)
nodes.norm_label: indicators in use (delta, badge, bar, status dot)
nodes.rationale: Vivid signal only in delta, badge, bar, status dot; never button or large area; gold remains only action colour.

nodes.label: Verde-oliva secondary palette
nodes.rationale: Brown structures, gold acts, olive supports; never primary button nor success signal; vivid green on olive only 2:1 contrast.

nodes.label: Semantic colours (success/danger/warning)
nodes.rationale: Vivid green and red are outside brand palette on purpose, used for signal.

nodes.label: Text on backgrounds contrast rules
nodes.rationale: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for body text; approved combinations.

nodes.label: Shadows and focus ring
nodes.rationale: Warm brown shadows never neutral grey; gold focus ring.

nodes.label: Motion tokens
nodes.rationale: Curve cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); short fades/slides, no bounce; durations 90/140/200/320/380ms.

nodes.label: Ovo di Onca logotype (gold/brown/cream variants)
nodes.rationale: Gold version on cream, brown for print, cream on brown.
